serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Bugcrowd for Government (BCGOV) is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform providing on-demand offensive security testing capabilities delivered through a vetted community of security researchers. The platform enables customers to establish and manage structured security programs, including Vulnerability Disclosure Programs (VDP), Bug Bounties, and Penetration Testing. BCGOV includes a centralized management portal for scope definition, asset management, and researcher engagement, a triage pipeline for vulnerability validation and severity rating, and APIs for integrating validated findings into customer remediation workflows.
